name: Tomb of Shah Shams Tabrez
short_description: Blue-tiled shrine of a revered Sufi saint near the Multan Fort.
description: The shrine of Shah Shams Sabzwari, often called Shah Shams Tabrez, is one of Multan's best-loved Sufi tombs. Its green dome and blue Multani tiles make it a landmark of the old city.
history: Built in honour of the Sufi saint Shah Shams Sabzwari; a place of pilgrimage for centuries.
significance: A living centre of Sufi devotion in the 'City of Saints'.
culture: Visitors come for prayers and qawwali on Thursday evenings.
local_customs: Dress modestly, remove shoes before entering, and women should cover their heads.
food: Try sohan halwa, Multan's famous sweet, from the old city shops.
shopping: Blue pottery and Multani khussa shoes are sold in the nearby bazaars.
tips: Visit in the early morning or evening; summers are very hot.
opening_hours: Open daily, sunrise to late evening
